pages.text: Tiers 5-8 are $(l)Fabricators$(): a square base of $(item)Printer Casing$() with a controller in the center. They print bigger, faster and cheaper.$(li)$(l)T5$(): 3x3$(li)$(l)T6$(): 5x5$(li)$(l)T7$(): 7x7$(li)$(l)T8$(): 9x9
$(item)Printer Casing$(): the building block of every Fabricator base. One craft yields $(l)four$(); a T5 needs 8, a T8 needs 76 (plus 4 Awakened Draconium corners).
The $(item)Tier 5 Fabricator$() controller, built around a Tier 4 printer and $(item)Extrudium Crystal$().

pages.title: Forming & Collapsing
pages.text: Lay the base, put the controller in the center, and $(l)right-click$() it to form. The casing lights up.$(br2)Breaking a formed controller collapses the machine into a $(l)single item$() that re-forms with its inventory, upgrades and stored RF intact.$(br2)Once formed, $(l)any casing$() stands in for the machine: power it or sneak-click it with the scanner.

pages.title: Tier 8: Draconic
pages.text: The $(item)Tier 8 Fabricator$() is the endgame. It requires $(l)Draconic Evolution$() to be installed, and its four base corners must be $(l)Awakened Draconium$() blocks instead of casing. Without Draconic Evolution it refuses to form.$(br2)DE gates $(l)both halves$(): the controller crafts from $(l)4 Nether Stars$() and $(l)4 Awakened Draconium Ingots$() around a $(item)Tier 7 Fabricator$().
